name: FoilStampStatement
job: A statement stamped in metallic foil whose sheen sweeps across the letters as the visitor tilts the pointer or phone
visitor_action: move the pointer across the statement to sweep the sheen; on touch, drag a finger across it; arrow keys move the sheen when focused
mobile: finger drag moves the sheen; slow idle sweep otherwise
motion: sheen band glides with spring lag following input, idle sweep every few seconds (reduced-motion: static foil gradient)
art_direction: Wedding stationer: deep bottle-green card, hot-stamped champagne foil with specular gradient, slight deboss shadow around letters
